## GADĀDHARA DĀSA

He was a resident of Vṛndāvana
pieces.title: Gadādhara Dāsa of Vṛndāvana (was in the record of Gadādhara dāsa, author of the Puruṣottama-māhātmya)

fields.notes: A resident of Vṛndāvana (Vaiṣṇava-vandanā 70). Taken out of the record #273, which is Gadādhara dāsa, brother of Kāśīrāma dāsa and author of the Puruṣottama-māhātmya (11-11-2026).
